scene: The dial click opens giant transport hangar doors across the yard.
picture: A flat side view of the vast repair yard platform. On the far left sits a puffing red steam train. Left of centre, the player sits in her purple wheelchair. In the centre, the workbench hums safely. On the right, a brass airship floats tethered. On the far right, an illuminated glass elevator stands open.
shown: a puffed steam train waiting on iron tracks on the far left
a floating brass airship tethered to a pylon on the right
a transparent cylindrical glass elevator with doors open on the far right

variants.scene: The great hangar doors slide back, revealing three magnificent ways to travel.
